entity.summary: Latvia-rooted centralized bitcoin/fiat exchange that was operating by 2017, remained active through 2020, later continued inside the Nexpay platform, and is now conservatively classified inactive because current tracking and API evidence no longer show an active Globitex order-book exchange.
entity.notes: The exchange business is distinct from the continuing Globitex Holding group. First-party material says the company shifted its primary platform branding toward Nexpay while explicitly retaining the Globitex exchange without interruption; later group materials center Nexpay and Nexdesk. Current third-party exchange tracking is untracked/inactive and an independently maintained Nexpay API client states that exchange trading methods became unavailable after the exchange was discontinued. No reliable first-party shutdown notice or exact discontinuation date was recovered, so HEI does not assign a death date or death reason. The 2017 launch marker is year-level normalization of public exchange operation and does not equate the exchange launch with the group's earlier 2015 founding history. The current `globitex.io` site is not treated as continuity of the historical `globitex.com` venue because no reviewed lineage evidence connects them.

events.title: Globitex was operating as a cryptocurrency exchange by 2017
events.description: Contemporaneous Globitex material described an existing bitcoin exchange and current exchange directories place its public launch in 2017.
events.notes: Year-level normalization only. HEI does not use the group's 2015 founding history as the exchange launch date, and does not assert a precise launch day.

evidence.title: Globitex Group Company Granted Electronic Money Institution Licence by EU Regulator
evidence.notes: Company-supplied release describes Globitex as a new bitcoin exchange and refers to scaling its existing exchange infrastructure. Used with secondary launch metadata only for a conservative 2017 year-level operation marker.

evidence.title: Globitex exchange profile
evidence.notes: Current exchange directory describes Globitex as a Latvia-headquartered centralized exchange launched in May 2017 and marks the listing untracked. HEI normalizes only the year and does not promote the directory's month/day into a precise canonical launch date.

evidence.title: Becoming the go-to financial infrastructure provider for European digital assets businesses
evidence.notes: First-party retrospective states that Globitex exchange volume grew more than threefold in 2020 and that the Globitex platform would become the Nexpay platform while the exchange continued without interruption. The page's current publication date is not used as the date of that historical platform transition because the text is explicitly retrospective and discusses 2021 as future planning.

evidence.title: Nexpay API client marks former exchange methods discontinued
evidence.notes: Maintained third-party API client labels market-data and trading methods as old methods no longer available since the Nexpay exchange was discontinued. It supports inactive classification but does not establish an exact shutdown date or cause.

evidence.title: NBX enters a strategic partnership with Globitex Holding AS
evidence.notes: Issuer disclosure identifies Globitex Holding AS as the holding company of UAB Nexpay and Nexdesk in 2025. It supports continuing corporate-group identity while not asserting that the historical Globitex order-book exchange itself remained active.
